# chameleon_principal (Resource)

Manages a Polaris principal (USER or SERVICE).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A SERVICE principal for an automated workload.
resource "chameleon_principal" "etl" {
  name = "etl-pipeline"
  type = "SERVICE"
  properties = {
    description = "Service principal for the ETL pipeline"
  }
}

# A USER principal (default type).
resource "chameleon_principal" "analyst" {
  name = "alice"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Principal name.

### Optional

- `properties` (Map of String) Free-form metadata attached to the principal.
- `type` (String) Principal type: USER or SERVICE. Defaults to USER.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) OAuth client ID assigned to the principal by Polaris.
- `id` (String) Principal name (used as the Terraform resource ID).
